resources.string: Show the story on the wallpaper
Start again from the first incident

The story moves forward one incident a day, kanda by kanda, from Valmiki\'s first verse to Sita\'s return to the Earth, then starts again. Paintings are by Raja Ravi Varma (1848–1906) and the Ravi Varma Press, now in the public domain, loaded from Wikimedia Commons. Incidents without a painting use the app\'s own artwork.
